ad_set.name: Consultants - Static Editorial - First Flight
ad_set.placement_recommendation: Desktop-focused first upload if Meta supports it cleanly. Prioritize desktop feeds / desktop traffic because Verbatim is a Chrome extension.
ad_set.mobile_desktop_constraint: Chrome extensions cannot be installed through normal mobile Chrome or iOS browser flows. Do not treat blended mobile plus desktop conversion rate as a valid extension adoption signal.
ad_set.mobile_reporting_note: If mobile placements are used, report them separately and do not judge extension adoption from mobile install conversion rate.

human_review_gates: Confirm /consultants page is live before publishing.
Confirm final Meta ad preview before publishing.
Confirm headline variant URLs resolve correctly.
Confirm Pixel Verbatim Website ID 26411512478545039 is selected.
Confirm objective is Traffic and performance goal is landing page views.
Confirm desktop-focused placement setup if Meta supports it cleanly.
Confirm mobile placement results are reported separately if mobile placements are used.
Confirm tracking and landing page view delivery before publishing.
Confirm no ad is marked published before final human approval.
do_not_upload_notes: Do not publish until the consultants landing page exists.
Do not publish until final previews are checked.
Do not publish until tracking verification is complete.
Do not publish if Meta Pixel / dataset selection is unclear.
Do not publish if placement settings blend mobile and desktop in a way that hides the extension install constraint.
Do not publish if any selected PNG is missing locally.
Do not invent Meta campaign, ad set, or ad IDs.
